concepts.definition: The STDO Axiomatic Calculus for Governed Symbolic Systems, abbreviated a_c: a domain-specific, carrier-neutral constitutional calculus for representing and relating governed symbolic systems. Its stable concept identity is urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:a-c, owned by this standard in urn:stdo:bounded-context:axiomatic-calculus. The concept identity does not identify an immutable edition.

grounding.quote: # The STDO Axiomatic Calculus for Governed Symbolic Systems
urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:a-c

concepts.definition: Sigma comprises RecordKind, Sort, RelationKind, ConstraintKind, ResidualKind, FunctorKind, JudgmentKind and StopKind, each a finite closed identity set for one model family. constraints.statement: F1–F6 supply purpose, interpretation, identity, composition, finite-capacity and authority premises. AC-003/004/006 require resolved compatible references on one exact basis before judgment consumption. Signature, record kinds, closure and functor classification are additional choices owned by this standard, not uniquely forced by foundations or predecessor provenance. AC-007/014 consume the shared result algebra and AC-016 its conjunction; the transformation library supplies reusable responsibilities without replacing AC-013 or proving categorical laws. Definitions are independent of derivation-record layout, selected interpretation, carrier, provider, runtime and repository. No universal applicability, completeness, consistency, decidability, soundness or categorical status is claimed absent the stated proof exception. Interpretation and encoding cannot redefine the calculus; released Product standing requires separate authorized acceptance and release.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced shared laws and exact proofs are not supplied.

grounding.quote: The derivation direction is one-way.

constraints.statement: The cited Identity, Spec and Reference Frame clause families are historical design provenance for scoped identity/authority conservation, bounded-context meaning and cross-context relations, bounded probabilistic evaluation/construction, exact candidates and construction-assessment separation, ambiguity/human adjudication/hard stops, exact-basis evaluation and evidence-verdict separation, closed results, constitutional re-entry, finite closure/projection/residuals/capability fit and singular released authority. The selected complete STDO cut supplies operative common owners; interpretation needs no implicit STDO representation, GTL carrier or downstream implementation. F_D/F_P/F_H are introduced here as policy-selected generic identities, not imported from equal-spelled graph/runtime/ODD/application shorthand. Nominal equality establishes no identity, import or equivalence. Basis issuance resolves relative authoring links into absolute predecessor-cut principle_refs within derivation_basis.release_uri; mutable links are not digest-bound references. No model, carrier, proof tool or successful application can amend source principles or this calculus.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced predecessor clauses and release resolution are unavailable.

grounding.quote: `a_c` governs the form of a symbolic axiomatic model.

constraints.statement: a_c governs symbolic model form: identities/types, exact relation endpoints, explicit constraints/latitude/residuals, typed traversals/judgments, closure/projection/overlay/transformation, subject preservation and distinctions among structural, semantic and authority claims. It does not select vocabulary/materiality, grant semantic acceptance, choose carriers, execute models or prove interpretation uniqueness. It is not a derivation-source representation/compression, selected subject model, carrier profile/instance, executable language/interpreter/compiler/runtime, deterministic semantic assessor/theorem prover, mandatory graph topology, world ontology, authority registry or claim of one vocabulary/relation set for all governed systems.

Unknown kinds/fields require a new signature or explicit compatible extension, not an extra subject sort. The signature specifies every sort/family's fields and values, identity-field cardinality/reference domains, relation endpoint sorts, constraint subject/predicate domains, residual subject/uncertainty/consequence/re-entry domains, judgment input/output/evidence/stop contracts and traversal functor permissions. Population_M is total; every finite fundamental record occurs in exactly one population with globally unique identity. Every external identity has exactly one signature-declared external domain and exact resolution. Hidden records, unpopulated extra families, duplicate population identity or an identity with neither one local record nor lawful external resolution refuse the model. RefDomain_Sigma(kind,field) returns cardinality, allowed local kinds, semantic sorts, external target kinds and required basis relation; every scalar/collection identity reference is checked through it.

Concrete sorts/cardinalities/reference domains belong to the signature owner and closed syntax does not establish their semantic adequacy. Context owners own identity/composite-basis relations; referenced owners retain meaning/grants. Subject/interpretation authorities determine latitude, material residuals and authorized dispositions. Closure seeds/edge semantics, transformation equality/loss/grants, traversal topology/outer predicates, semantic selection/admitted loss and downstream Product applications/carriers/releases remain their respective owners' choices. grounding.quote:

constraints.statement: Each constraint binds applies_to, predicate, basis, judgment_kind, latitude_ref and refusal to Evaluate. The shared core owns five verdicts, legal performance pairs, effects and missing reasons. Established exact predicate under governing latitude maps to satisfied; admissible counterexample to falsified; undecidable evidence, including missing required reason, to indeterminate; needed material scope/capability outside contract to out_of_frame; uninterpretable subject/governing basis to invalid_basis. Diagnosis and missing-reason handling retain independent counterevidence; multiple required predicates use core conjunction. Returned projection/successor/model satisfies only an established production predicate; missing output defeats it only with contract/evidence support. accepted/admitted assess their own decision predicate over unchanged subject, mandate and bound authority: lawful supported decision is satisfied, established contract violation falsified, undecided decision/grant indeterminate. Other diagnoses apply to the evaluation lacking scope/capability/basis. hold/gap/refusal/refuse require a cause with the same reason-sensitive mapping. Established prohibition falsifies only the defeated permission/admission predicate; absent interpreter grant does not falsify the model constraint. Retain actual constraint evaluation performance, separate admissible counterevidence/diagnoses; without deciding support it remains indeterminate and permission refusal is separately bound. Bare stop words cannot satisfy consumers. Implementations bind mappings before execution and retain performance, known effects, evidence and residuals; no outcome upgrades actual performance/effects or establishes another model's semantic truth.
constraints.uncertainty: Full shared diagnosis, performance-pair, missing-reason and conjunction definitions are outside the supplied source.

constraints.statement: Judgment cannot change or acquire the identity/authority of a changed subject; promotion is an explicit relation between unchanged subject and admission/acceptance judgment. Every semantic field is required; the selected signature closes domains/cardinalities/reference domains. Exact interpretation declares the original-decision-to-core-result map before use. predicate resolves its adopted contract and identity-bearing residuals resolve existing residual records. effects records shared effect state at the predicate/evidence boundary; subject/evidence/provenance identify operation and observation, without introducing a nested effect-identity schema. Actor, executor, domain operation and kind are distinct; Encode/Interpret/Serialize/Measure are not aliases for F_D/F_P/F_H. Shared kind does not imply shared identity, semantics, inputs, outputs, authority or evidence. F_P usefulness/repeatability grants no semantic/admission/acceptance/closure authority; F_H requires exact identity/grant/subject/basis/decision contract, and human presence confers none. Candidate availability does not establish conformity/acceptance; evaluation and disposition require their own predicates/evidence, and completed human decision does not make rejection conformity. constraints.statement: Interpretation owner selects subject/signature/materiality/admitted loss within competent source and acceptance ownership; construction does not accept its proposal. Faithful projection binds exact declarations, signature/contract target meaning and declared consumer use. Each admitted record maps to exact provenance or authorized model-local content. Every evaluated declaration has retained/omitted/residual/inapplicable/refused treatment. The treatment predicate assesses preservation of material meaning for use: established preservation including authorized omission/loss -> satisfied; admissible fidelity counterexample -> falsified; undecided preservation/authority/materiality -> indeterminate; missing scope/capability -> out_of_frame; unusable subject/interpretation basis -> invalid_basis; missing reason follows AC-007. Overall fidelity conjoins required declaration/dependency predicates. Faithful uncertainty representation may satisfy fidelity while source claim stays unresolved; treatment permission refusal does not decide source truth. O/E/C/L/X/V/T/J preserve meanings, typed dependencies, predicates/consequences, choices, unresolved conditions and operations; sorts/qualifiers/predicates distinguish premises, consequences, policy, observations and unresolved claims without a new family/fixed tree. hold or refusal cannot be

grounding.quote: It does not mandate one optimal authoring path for every agent, worker, or

Discovery closes only for that basis/cutoff. Material frontier-changing discovery gaps prevent selection; immaterial residuals justify inability to change decision. Stay inside Product and admitted migration strategy; do not choose evolution vs re-adoption or override Spec's rebuttable strategy presumption. For every material candidate compare decision-changing fit/constructability, semantic or operation leakage, adapter/integration/migration/deletion/future-code costs, license/maintenance/security/upgrade/supply chain, package/runtime/startup/storage/operation cost, determinism/concurrency/failure/recovery/reconstruction/replay, assurance burden and exit/replacement/reversibility. A material unknown that could reverse
the relation prevents dominance and remains a gap.

Fewest dependencies, smallest edit/line count or richest features do not determine selection; rejected material candidates record decisive evidence/falsifier. Foundations may realize explicitly assigned authority-bearing roles only while preserving owner/role/subject/scope/basis/lifecycle/refusal invariants; capability/provenance/authorship cannot widen/remint roles. well-formedness is a different predicate.

conditions: Prime policy applies to proposed top-level functions, classes, carrier types, schema records and modules.

grounding.quote: Typed closure by itself is **not** sufficient reason to create a new top-level

constraints.statement: Derive Prime atoms from logically complete candidate Ontology before top-level units; whole-family Prime evidence supports Ontology acceptance and downstream design/IACS/modules/functions/schemas/tests project accepted atoms. Typed closure alone does not justify new top-level types. Units are Prime-conformant only if projecting accepted atoms without new/duplicate/reinterpreted authority; topology/effect boundaries first require accepted Prime derivation. Size and one-to-one atom mapping are immaterial. Typical lawful reasons include admitted graph topology, typed carrier transform, effect, validation/admission or projection boundaries, subject to those prerequisites. Units solely shortening calls, aggregating unrelated convenience behavior, renaming old interfaces, adding wrappers, concealing mutation/fallback/orchestration, naming nonauthoritative payload variants, publishing internal detail without irreducible boundary, mirroring carriers with small changes or proliferating types for typing discomfort are not conformant. Prefer composition, existing lawful functions and fewer sharper boundaries/families; purpose is preventing semantic fragmentation/helper sprawl, not minimizing lines.

constraints.statement: Review cuts, realization units, runtime modules and work items are distinct and cannot be forced one-to-one for administrative convenience. Contraction accounts for governance cost as well as unit count and is unsuccessful if it increases authority centers, maintained truth surfaces, acceptance boundaries, dependency cycles, manual projection reconciliation or review burden. Evidence is proportional to semantic change and risk.

constraints.statement: Derive IACS from accepted Ontology before naming subordinate payloads/modules; the set should precede helper results/internal detail. Possible roles include source truth, admission, execution, yield/recovery, effect plan and public projection, not a fixed required inventory. Branch payload, persistence detail, read-row shape and typing-only field grouping do not automatically justify top-level carriers. Evidence cites accepted Ontology/function derivation, declares set, maps every carrier to carried identity/lifecycle/function/authority/effect/projection law, distinguishes authoritative/downstream carriers, defaults all other shapes to subordinate/private unless Promotion Test passes, and reconciles typed implementation before closure. IACS cannot replace Ontology or originate entities/functions/lifecycle/authority. Missing declared accepted Ontology or IACS means schema not yet design-method complete. Before promotion/closure both must be accepted and implementation reconciled; gated mode accepts affected unresolved/contradictory/non-equivalent relation before retained implementation establishes it.
constraints.uncertainty: The full Promotion Test is not supplied.
